verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an eSignature REST API reference and Developer Center, and publishes official OpenAPI/Swagger specifications that let humans and machines discover the API's capabilities. That establishes a first-party API reference, but nothing in the pack shows interactivity or runnable examples. The Postman workflow in the community evidence is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or runnable in-browser examples, hands-on corroboration of interactivity, and a machine-fetchable OpenAPI endpoint on the developer site (probes returned 404).
